description: Trigger the agent to act on a consumer conversation asynchronously - the event is queued and the call returns immediately with status "accepted" and an agent_event_id. Poll mba_get_agent_event with that id to find out what happened; a 202-style acknowledgement here does not mean the consumer was messaged. Known limitation: event.payload must be a JSON-ESCAPED STRING, not an object - pass "{\"order_id\":\"123\"}", not {"order_id": "123"}. Maximum 4096 characters.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

description.description: What happened, in words the agent can act on (max 1024 characters).

payload.description: Opaque JSON-ENCODED STRING passed to the agent as-is (max 4096 characters).

to.description: Consumer's WhatsApp number in E.164 format.

name: mba_send_agent_event
title: Send an agent event
